name: Soma Eipl
title: Infrastructure & DevOps Engineer
about: Working toward infrastructure and DevOps-focused roles, with my strongest hands-on comfort in Python, VPS/Linux operations, and Cloudflare & DNS management. I build and extend the rest of my skill set through real side projects - often working alongside AI tooling, but always making sure I understand what the pieces are actually doing.
I regularly configure and troubleshoot VPS infrastructure, manage DNS and Cloudflare routing, and have handled mail system migrations, with a focus on stability and security-oriented configuration.

On the side, I build and deploy my own projects: Dockerized applications, GitHub Actions pipelines with automated VPS deployment, and structured post-deploy security audits - a mix of things I'm confident in and things I'm still actively learning.
I've also touched structured data systems - redesigning reporting logic around bookkeeping data models and rebuilding calculated fields from legacy MDB/DLL sources for dashboard reporting.
lookingFor: Right now, I'm growing toward infrastructure- and security-focused roles where I can own systems end to end - the kind of work this site's own deploy pipeline and VPS hardening already represent.

principles.name: Fail fast
principles.desc: Surface problems early instead of letting them hide.

principles.name: Keep it simple (KISS)
principles.desc: The simplest solution that actually solves the problem, nothing more.

principles.name: Defense in depth
principles.desc: Layer independent protections instead of relying on a single control.

principles.name: Least privilege
principles.desc: Grant only the access a component or key actually needs.

principles.name: Single source of truth
principles.desc: One place owns a piece of data or config; everything else reads from it.

principles.name: Idempotency
principles.desc: Re-running an operation should be safe and produce the same result.

principles.name: Root cause, not symptoms
principles.desc: Trace a bug to its actual cause before patching around it.

principles.name: Reversibility
principles.desc: Back up, branch, and commit so mistakes are cheap to undo.
